title: Turn on screen reader mode
intro: Pick how you want to enable it.

show.title: On for this session
show.detail: Claude Code shows plain, labeled text that screen readers follow well.

show.title: On every time
show.detail: Your user settings turn it on for all sessions.

show.title: Ignored
show.detail: Project settings can't turn screen reader mode on; it's a personal choice.

trace.text: This setting only counts in user settings.

fallback.title: Pick an option
fallback.detail: Choose one of the options to see what happens.

quiz.question: What do menus look like in screen reader mode?
quiz.explanation: Menus become numbered lists you can answer by number.
